Regarding the text provided, the main theme is **legacy**. The narrative explores the profound weight of responsibility that comes with preserving humanity, as characters on a spaceship must confront how their past actions and future decisions will shape the survival of their species. The story highlights the emotional duality of this journey: the hope and optimism associated with starting anew on a new world, contrasted with the grief and loss of leaving Earth behind. Ultimately, the text emphasizes the burden of stewardship and the complex emotions tied to the continuity of human existence.
